title: Micro Water Pump: ~3m Effective Range at 12V, Brownout Risk Confirmed
context: Splash water gun drone needs effective stream range from safe altitude (>2m). Pump inrush current could brownout FC mid-flight.
what_was_found: Physics estimate: 2mm nozzle at 1 L/min = 5.3 m/s exit velocity, ~3m horizontal range at 30° downward from 2m altitude. Pump inrush: 2-3A for <100ms. During motor flight (4 motors at 5-10A each), system draw could sag battery below FC minimum.
mitigation: 1000µF capacitor on 12V payload rail to buffer inrush. If FC voltage dips >0.5V, add dedicated 12V boost from battery. 3D-printed 2mm converging nozzle improves stream coherence 30-50%.
action: GROUND TEST MANDATORY: measure steady-state current, inrush (oscilloscope), stream distance at 12V, coherence at 1m/2m/3m.
